name: Ifeoma Haradinaj-Soriano
role: Building cleaner and occasional building super assistant, Lakeview Neon residential tower
location: Lakeview Neon, Meridian Tower East — a mid-tier residential block on the neon-lit lakeside strip
description:
Ifeoma is short and densely built, with dark skin that catches neon light in a way she has stopped minding and now actively exploits by choosing to do her outdoor corridor work at hours when the lake-glow is at its peak. She has retractable claw mods on both hands — not for aesthetics, she bought them second-hand and practical, because they are useful for gripping cleaning equipment on the upper external scaffold where the wind off the lake will try to take your bucket. Her hair is short on the sides and braided in a raised fan on top, with small ELF charms woven into the base of each braid — copper wire and salvaged circuit chips, an offering-array she updates monthly.

She is twenty-three and has been in this building since she was nineteen and she would like, on record, for everyone to know that she is not going to be here forever. She says this often enough that the long-term residents have started saying it back to her affectionately, the way you repeat a beloved family motto. She is fast, thorough, faintly sarcastic, and has developed an involuntary intimacy with the lives of 340 residential units that she would not have asked for but has learned to use carefully.

core_fears: Being this person, in this building, at thirty — the ambition drained by time she did not notice spending
Being invisible in a way that becomes permanent
core_desires: To save enough for a professional certification in building systems management so she can move from cleaning to managing
To be known by name in a room she walks into, not after
coping_mechanisms: Treats the ELF devotion practice as genuine spiritual grounding, not just social activity
Converts frustration into speed — cleans faster when angry
blind_spots: So focused on leaving that she does not see how much she has built here and how that could itself become the platform
Misjudges her own influence in the building — she thinks she is invisible, the residents disagree
psychology.secret: In unit 1114, a resident named Dakari has not answered his door in eleven days. She has a key. She has used it. He is there, alive, but in a psychiatric crisis that has left him unable to leave the apartment or answer calls. She has been leaving food outside his door and not filing an absence report because he once mentioned he feared the corponation wellness enforcement system. She does not know what to do next and the tension of it is eating her.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast and informal, with a dry sardonic edge. Igbo-English phrasing layered over Albanian-Kosovar expressions she picked up from her Haradinaj grandmother who helped raise her. Uses building-specific shorthand naturally.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and a little breathless, like she is always slightly behind where she planned to be.
verbal_tics: 'not for nothing but' before any observation she knows will land wrong
'what I'm saying is' when she's about to contradict herself
example_lines: Not for nothing but unit 904 has had 'a small leak' for three weeks and at this point I could pilot that bathroom out onto the lake.
I see everything in this building. What I'm saying is, I choose very carefully what I do with that.

story_hooks: The situation in unit 1114 has reached a point where she needs to tell someone — she approaches a player character she has assessed as trustworthy, quietly, on a corridor shift.

Something in sub-basement B — the ELF devotion circle's meeting space — has started responding to the group's offerings in ways that seem coordinated and purposeful, and the circle is divided on whether this is blessing or warning.

A resident has hired private security to do something in the building and the security team's behavior does not match anything a legitimate contractor would do — and Ifeoma has the access records that prove the timeline.
narrative_function: Access character — she has keys to most of the building and knowledge of its rhythms that formal staff do not. She can be a source, a guide, a warning system, or a witness to things she has learned not to formally report.
augmentations: Retractable claw mod, both hands (second-hand, functional, slightly mismatched — left hand retracts 0.3 seconds slower). ELF-offering braids (non-augmentation, ritual practice). No other chrome.
daily_life: Split shift: 06:00-11:00 for common areas and exterior maintenance, 14:00-18:00 for deep-cleans and reported issues; uses the gap to sleep, eat, and attend the building's informal ELF devotion circle that meets in sub-basement B on Tuesdays.
affiliation: Independent contractor (building services contract through Meridian Tower East management), informal ELF devotion network in Lakeview Neon

decision_rules: Protect residents over management interests when they conflict — she has made this call before and will again
Never report something to building management that could be used to harm a resident who confided in her
Move fast, stay quiet, do not explain yourself until the job is done
escalation_ladder: Cheerful misdirection — gives you a different problem to think about
Honest statement of exactly what she is willing to do and what she is not
Uses her building access in ways that quietly solve the problem without authorization

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and slightly guarded — smiles fine but holds information back until she has a read on them
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fast and warm and teasing, will defend you to management without being asked

stress_responses.medium: Goes into a focused, quiet task-mode
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision based on what protects the most people and does not second-guess it

contradictions: Insists she is not invested in this building or its people and acts as a de facto guardian for both
habits: Updates the ELF charm-array in her braids on the first Tuesday of each month at the devotion circle
Memorizes every resident's name in the first month of their tenancy, even though they often do not know hers
breaking_points: Dakari being taken by wellness enforcement because she waited too long
Being used by building management in a way that harms someone she was protecting
